features:
- [PURGE GOOGLE ACCOUNT 100%] Tu dong cap phat sqlite3 ARM64 portable, xoa sach triet de moi bang accounts, authtokens, grants, extras va xoa truc tiep DB token GMS (auth.db, signin.db), giai phong cache RAM AccountManagerService.
- [TASKBAR LIVE MASTER/SLAVE] Gan truc tiep nut chon Master va o tick Slave ngay tren dinh tung cua so Live Scrcpy. Nhan dien Master qua nut do ruc [MASTER] tren taskbar, bo vien do overlay.
- [ZERO-LAG & HIGH-PRECISION SYNC] Toi uu toa do bang Win32 Client Area chuan xac tung diem anh va phat lenh bat dong bo Fire & Forget xoa so 100% do tre (lag).
- [DYNAMIC VERSION UI] Dong bo hien thi phien ban dong v1.8.4 tren tieu de cua so va badge sidebar.
changelog:
